picks.title: Bot-detection startup Spur nabs $200M from Insight
picks.why_it_matters: A $200M growth round in bot detection signals strong investor conviction that AI-generated traffic is creating massive demand for authentication infrastructure—a space where early-stage startups can still carve out specialized niches.

picks.title: LearnVector – Andrew Ng's AI company building one‑to‑one learning experiences
picks.why_it_matters: Andrew Ng launching an AI-native education startup validates the AI tutoring thesis and will likely accelerate founder and investor interest in personalized learning—creating both competitive pressure and legitimacy for the category.

picks.title: MCP startup Runlayer accuses Rippling of stealing its product idea
picks.why_it_matters: This lawsuit highlights both the strategic importance of MCP gateway infrastructure in the emerging agent ecosystem and the existential risk startups face when enterprise incumbents evaluate their products during sales cycles.
